cultivation_relevance: Leading commercial fibre crop in India. Gujarat is India's largest cotton producer, predominantly cultivating Bt cotton hybrids.

climate_and_soil.temperature_range_celsius: 21°C to 35°C during vegetative stage, 26°C to 32°C during boll maturation
climate_and_soil.drainage: Excellent drainage mandatory; highly intolerant to waterlogging exceeding 24-48 hours

seasons: Kharif (June - July sowing under rainfed or semi-irrigated conditions)

planting_details.sowing_time: May 15 to June 30 with pre-monsoon irrigation; onset of monsoon for rainfed
planting_details.seed_rate: 1.5 to 2.0 kg hybrid seed (approx 2 packets of 450g each per acre)
planting_details.spacing: 120 cm x 45 cm (for medium soils) or 90 cm x 60 cm (for heavy black soils)
planting_details.sowing_depth: 3.0 to 5.0 cm into moist soil ridge

nutrient_management.fym_manure_per_acre: 4 to 5 tonnes well-rotted farmyard manure applied during land preparation
nutrient_management.recommended_npk_ratio: 120:60:60 kg/ha (approx 48:24:24 kg/acre N:P2O5:K2O for irrigated hybrid Bt cotton)
micronutrients: Zinc Sulphate @ 10 kg/acre basal in deficient soils
Magnesium Sulphate foliar spray @ 10 g/L for chlorosis

harvest_and_yield.harvesting_signs: Complete opening of fluffy white bolls; morning picking after dew evaporates
harvest_and_yield.expected_yield_per_acre: 10 to 16 Quintals seed cotton (Kapas) per acre under good management
harvest_and_yield.post_harvest_storage: Dry in shade to <8% moisture; store in moisture-proof gunny bags away from chemicals
